title: LEI Data-Quality Grading Worksheet
description: Grade the data quality of a pasted GLEIF LEI record across six dimensions (registration status, renewal timeliness, corroboration level, entity status, Level-2 parent disclosure, address completeness), then disposition each finding (accept/flag/escalate) into a tamper-evident KYB worksheet receipt. Paste-mode. Zero egress. Zero PII.

record.description: GLEIF JSON:API lei-records response body (pasted, never fetched)

worksheet_receipt.description: Hash-chained disposition receipt (record digest, grader version, grades, disposition chain, timestamp)

mcp_tool_definition.name: grade_lei_data_quality
mcp_tool_definition.description: Grade a pasted GLEIF lei-records JSON record across six data-quality dimensions and return per-dimension grades plus a composite. Grades data quality of the record only — not creditworthiness, sanctions status, or entity legitimacy.

regulatory_frameworks: GLEIF Global LEI Data Quality Report
